_readme: Conversation suite for scripts/eval-conversations.ts: end-to-end checks of what a visitor sees. Every bug found in testing becomes a case here, so it can't come back unnoticed. Deterministic checks: route, tools (mustNotCall ["*"] = no tool at all), deepDive card, retrieved documents, and exact facts (mentionsAll: case-insensitive regexes, each inner list an any-of group; mentionsNone). Meaning is checked by an AI grader against answer.judge, never with word lists. Every reply is also checked for text and for citations that point at retrieved documents; a missing FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS block is a warning.
